buildCommand: if [ ! -d flutter ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b 3.44.0 --depth 1; fi && flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && cd app && ../flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
